lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, with inter-spot distance increasing toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot rows, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running parallel along the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp luminance transition from light upper margins to shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low density of high-luminance blobs distributed primarily along the base and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark elongated silhouettes adjacent to the ventral region and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
